spec.title: Synthetic 30-second boyfriend-POV home vlog
spec.brief: 30-second intimate boyfriend-POV home vlog: a fictional synthetic subject drinks tea at the kitchen table, walks to the bedroom, sits on the bed, and covers the lens. Reference images are synthetic; no real person is depicted.
spec.style: intimate handheld boyfriend-POV home vlog, natural and unposed

continuity_bible.subject_identity: Mira, a fictional adult woman who exists only as a synthetic reference image. She is rendered from the three synthetic reference images in this job. No real person is depicted, and no real person's likeness was used.
immutable_face_traits: soft oval face with a slightly rounded jaw
dark brown eyes with a single eyelid crease
small mole below the outer corner of the left eye
natural skin texture, no heavy smoothing
hair: long dark brown hair, straight, parted slightly left of centre
small silver hair clip on the right side, worn throughout
accessories: thin silver ring on the right hand
small silver hair clip, right side
outfit: oversized cream knit sweater with a wide collar
environment_topology: one small apartment with a kitchen at one end and a bedroom at the other
kitchen doorway on the right of the table, reached in a few steps
short hallway between the kitchen and the bedroom
one window on the left of the kitchen table, daylight only
lighting: soft morning daylight from the kitchen window
ordinary warm indoor light, no coloured gels
camera_grammar: one continuous handheld take, boyfriend POV
close conversational distance, phone at chest height
subtle natural sway, no stabiliser look
no cut, no zoom, no whip pan
interaction_style: unposed and spontaneous, aware of the camera but not performing
small natural movements, no commercial acting
